source_row.rationale: Irritability, difficulty concentrating, increased appetite, and cravings are common signs of nicotine withdrawal in a hospitalized smoker unable to use tobacco. The nurse can help address these symptoms and support the client's comfort through strategies such as nicotine replacement therapy (patches, gum) per provider order, which can also serve as an opportunity to discuss smoking cessation resources.
